parts.text: $TROW Q3 2026: revenue $2.0B, +6% Y/Y, driven by investment advisory fees, while net earnings fell 5% to $597M. Operating margin 38.4%; operating cash flow $543M. #earnings #finance
$HGV Q3 2026: revenue $2.0B, up 51% Y/Y driven by strong vacation ownership interest sales. Operating margin reached 25.1%; net earnings $297M. #earnings #consumer
$DLR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue reached $1.9B, +21% Y/Y, driven by record leasing and an expanding backlog. Operating margin was 15.9%. #earnings #REITs
$RXO Q3 2026: revenue $1.9B, +32% Y/Y, driven by a 48% increase in truck brokerage revenue per load from higher freight rates and fuel prices. Operating margin 0.9%. #earnings #industrials
$XEL Q3 2026: revenue $1.8B, up 5% Y/Y, driven by seasonal electric and natural gas sales. Operating margin was 24.3% as operations benefited from nuclear life extensions. #earnings #utilities
$GVA Q3 2026: revenue $1.8B, +23% Y/Y, driven by construction segment growth and higher committed and awarded projects. Operating margin 12.7%. #earnings #industrials

$OLN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.7B, +2% Y/Y, driven by higher Epoxy and Winchester sales as Chlor Alkali declined. Operating margin 3.4%; net earnings $14M. Expects Huntsman merger to close Q1 2027. #earnings #materials

$H Q3 2026: revenue $1.7B, -2% Y/Y, as owned and leased revenues declined primarily from the sale of the Playa Hotels portfolio, offset by higher fee revenues. Operating margin 4.5%; net earnings $61M. #earnings #consumer
$NSP Q3 2026: revenue $1.7B, +2% Y/Y, driven by higher pricing offsetting a drop in paid WSEEs from margin recovery efforts. Operating margin -0.1% as operating expenses fell. #earnings #industrials

$HAS Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, flat Y/Y, driven by growth in Wizards of the Coast and Digital Gaming led by Magic: The Gathering. Operating margin reached 32.4%; operating cash flow $303M. #earnings #consumer

$SNDR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +9% Y/Y, as truckload earnings doubled on network profitability and dedicated actions. Operating margin 3.9%. Raising full-year guidance. #earnings #industrials
$RBLX Q3 2026: revenue reached $1.6B, up 16% Y/Y, driven by platform activity. Operating cash flow was $395M as investments in infrastructure and safety continued. #earnings #software
